title: Chapter 563 - 563 Deathmatch; Good Friends!
content:
Chapter 563 - 563 Deathmatch; Good Friends!

Chapter 563 - 563 Deathmatch; Good Friends!

563 Deathmatch; Good Friends!

The matter on the internet continued to ferment, and it was at the top of the trending list for several days.

Lin Fan did not pay any attention to this.

Today, Lin Fan, who had nothing to do, took a first-class flight to Modu.

In order to prevent Qin Yuxuan from going on a business trip, Lin Fan called her in advance.

When Lin Fan arrived at the Global Financial Tower, the employees of Fan Yu Investment Company were all very busy.

However, it seemed a little strange that they were so busy today.

That was because Lin Fan noticed that many employees would look up at the door from time to time. Their faces were filled with anticipation.

At this moment, the beautiful receptionist raised her head with an expectant gaze, just like the other employees.

In the next moment…

She quickly stood up and respectfully said, “Hello, Mr. Lin.”

Lin Fan nodded his head, “Is Yuxuan here?”

“Yes, she’s in the office now,” the receptionist said.

As she spoke, she was about to walk out of the front desk and lead the way.

Lin Fan waved his hand. “No need. I can go over myself.”

After all, he had been to Fan Yu Investment Company many times.

In fact, Lin Fan had even chosen this office when he first came over.

He was very familiar with the place!

“Please come in.” Qin Yuxuan’s crisp voice came from inside.

Lin Fan pushed open the door.

Qin Yuxuan continued to approve another document before raising her head.

When she saw that it was Lin Fan, her pretty face was filled with smiles. She said, “What do you want to drink?”

“Green tea,” Lin Fan said.

“Alright,” Qin Yuxuan replied.

Usually, Qin Yuxuan’s coffee and tea would be served by her secretary.

However, she personally brewed tea for Lin Fan.

After a while, a faint fragrance filled the entire office.

Lin Fan took a sip and asked, “Have you been busy recently?”

Qin Yuxuan said, “I am busy, but I like this feeling. It is fulfilling and satisfying.”

Lin Fan said, “It’s good to be fulfilled, but you still need to rest.”

If it was someone else who said this, Qin Yuxuan would definitely not care.

She might even think that the other party was long-winded.

However, when Lin Fan said it, it made her heart feel sweet.

“Alright,” Qin Yuxuan said with a smile.

Lin Fan took another sip of tea and asked, “By the way, I see that the employees outside seem to be waiting for someone.”

Initially, he thought that Qin Yuxuan had informed them that he was coming, which was why the employees were waiting.

However, judging from the beautiful receptionist’s reaction, it did not seem to be the case.

Qin Yuxuan was about to answer.

Suddenly, a passionate voice sounded outside.

“She’s so beautiful!”

“She’s even more beautiful than on TV!”

“Don’t push.”

“Let me take a photo too.”

“Can I have your autograph?”

“I want an autographed photo.”

…

Qin Yuxuan smiled. “She should be here. Come, let’s go out and take a look. You know her.”

Know her?

Lin Fan nodded his head in confusion.

The door opened.

The two of them walked forward shoulder to shoulder.

The crowded employees quickly made way for the two of them.

In the next moment…

A voluptuous figure with exquisite facial features appeared in their field of vision. It was Ling Rou.

When Lin Fan saw her, he was stunned.

Lin Fan remembered that the last time he saw Ling Rou was when she won the Golden Melody Awards.

Unexpectedly, the next time they met was at Fan Yu Investment Company!

His two women were meeting… Was this considered a battlefield?

…

When Ling Rou saw Lin Fan, she was stunned.

Obviously, she did not expect to see Lin Fan.

Only Qin Yuxuan was very calm. She smiled and said, “Ling Rou, welcome to Fan Yu Investment. I believe that because of your endorsement, our Fan Yu Investment will be known by more people.”

As she spoke, she stretched out her slender hand.

Ling Rou was stunned for a moment before she reached out her hand and said, “Thank you.”

Qin Yuxuan introduced, “This is the real boss of our company, Lin Fan.”

Under the gaze of Qin Yuxuan, Ling Rou and Lin Fan reached out their hands to shake hands.

Qin Yuxuan smiled. “I’m a fan. Come, let’s go to my office first. How about that?”

“Alright,” Ling Rou looked at Lin Fan and said.

Qin Yuxuan, Ling Rou, and Lin Fan slowly walked into the office while surrounded by the employees.

Qin Yuxuan locked the door.

“Ling Rou, I just brewed this tea. Why don’t you come and have a taste?”

Ling Rou took a sip.

It tasted sweet and refreshing.

This was Spirit Tea!

Qin Yuxuan said, “Ling Rou, I like your song Galaxy the most. It’s so good! Whether it’s the lyrics or the tune, everything is perfect! There was a period of time where I would listen to it a few times every day…”

Ling Rou looked at Lin Fan and stuttered, “Oh… is that so?”

Qin Yuxuan said, “Of course. Actually, I also saw the publicity for your first concert, but I was too busy at that time, so I could not make it.”

Lin Fan picked up the teacup and drank a mouthful of tea. He almost choked.

What if Qin Yuxuan had gone to the concert?

At that time, Lin Fan had called Huang Ling, Qiu Ziqian, Xia Bing, Xia Xue, Han Tian, Hu Tian, and the rest over.

If they suddenly met, it would be a deathmatch.

Qin Yuxuan patted Lin Fan’s back gently and asked, “Are you alright? Drink slowly. No one’s gonna snatch it from you.”

Lin Fan nodded. “Alright…” Alright.”

Qin Yuxuan said to Ling Rou. “Ling Rou, I’m actually from Jiang Province! My hometown is in Qing City, which is very close to Jiangbei! Because I didn’t go to your concert, I regretted it for a long time.

“By the way, who’s the lyricist and composer for Galaxy? That person must be very talented, right? Do they have any other songs?”

Ling Rou looked at Lin Fan again and said, “He’s really talented. Unfortunately, there’s only one song by him for now.”

Qin Yuxuan sighed and said, “That’s a pity.”

The two of them held hands and chatted and laughed.

That appearance… It was like they were friends who had known each other for many years.

They chatted for more than an hour.

If they were thirsty, they would drink some Spirit Tea and immediately feel refreshed.

Therefore, they did not feel tired at all.

At this moment, Qin Yuxuan said, “It’s getting late. I’ve already made a reservation at Li Family Cuisine. Let’s go eat together first.”

Ling Rou was a little hesitant. “Isn’t it too troublesome?”

“What trouble?” Qin Yuxuan smiled. “The food served at Li Family Cuisine is very delicious. Moreover, you don’t have to worry about being disturbed by others. I specially booked a private room.”

Then, Qin Yuxuan did not wait for Ling Rou to say anything more. She held her hand and walked out.

Seeing this…

Lin Fan could only follow behind silently.
